summary: Banco Santander filed a Form 6-K reporting ongoing share buyback program transactions from April 16-23, 2026. The program has repurchased approximately €2.83 billion, representing 56.3% of the maximum investment amount, and has bought back ~16.9% of outstanding shares as of 2021. Daily purchases include 11,994,505 shares at weighted average prices around €10.32-10.79 on XMAD, CEUX, TQEX, and AQEU exchanges. The buyback was authorized by the Board in February 2026. Watch for continued execution pace until the maximum is reached.
